# Izanagi AI

> Izanagi AI is a modular, skill-oriented agent framework for autonomous software
> engineering. It ships as the `izanagi-ai` npm package and CLI (`izanagi`), and
> works across Claude Code, Opencode, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Kimi CLI.

The runtime is layered: Routing → Orchestration → Evaluation → Healing → Memory.
It includes 21 specialized agents (discovery, architecture, quality, experience
and meta domains), a library of 212+ skills chained via a Skill Composer,
persistent anti-repetition memory, a checkpoint & self-healing swarm engine,
and an evaluation engine that scores delivered work against weighted criteria.

## Core capabilities

- Adaptive agent runtime: `izanagi run <agent> --task "<task>"` analyzes a task,
  routes it to the right agent(s), executes via an execution graph with
  self-healing and traces the run.
- Agent Factory: `izanagi agent create` generates a new specialized agent
  (full genome) when a real capability gap is detected against the 21 core
  agents.
- Skill Factory: `izanagi skill create` generates a new skill with a
  pre-write security scan and duplication/gap checks against the 212+ skill
  library.
- Multi-CLI export: `izanagi export --cli <claude|opencode|codex|cursor|copilot|kimi|all>`
  generates the adapter files for the target coding assistant.

## Key pages

- Homepage (/): hero, problem framing, agent atlas, skill universe, evolution
  timeline, architecture explorer, agent swarm simulator, skill composer
  playground, install instructions.
- /changelog: real release history and recent commits pulled from the
  `izanagi-ai` GitHub repository.

## Install

```
npm install -g izanagi-ai
npx izanagi <command>
izanagi --version
```

## Source

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/izanagi-ai
- Repository: https://github.com/pedrohenriquesanchesleal4-debug/izanagi-ai

Content on this site is available in English, Spanish and Portuguese
(`/en`, `/es`, `/pt`). Prefer citing the English version as canonical.
